bagPolicy.summary: Only clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or small clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches are listed in the venue’s clear-bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Event parking costs $10 per vehicle, paid by cash or card on arrival or added at online ticket checkout.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue home page and official FAQ do not identify a concert rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue advertises its Encore Lounge, which opens two hours before showtime. The FAQ lists food as an amenity but does not give a universal menu.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The official FAQ lists a parking and accessibility section but does not give a specific accessible concert entrance or seating procedure in its readable text.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The official venue FAQ does not state a general re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open Monday–Friday from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., and from noon on show days. It does not publish a universal will-call ID rule.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The Encore Lounge opens two hours before showtime; the main auditorium door time depends on the concert. The box office opens at noon on show days.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
